description: A shell script containing tests for Git commands outside a repository, including setup, diff, hash, apply, grep, and other Git operations, with various test cases and expected outcomes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in files.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that a command exits with a specific code.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
